---
title: "Job watch"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
    toc-location: left
    df-print: default
params:
  root: "job-watch"
  week: "2026-W01"
  script_dir: "."
  today: "2026-01-01"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# Reads only what the stage functions wrote. Nothing here fetches anything.
# Static tables only (kableExtra, CSS-only styling): no htmlwidget JS. Chromium refuses to run script
# tags (module or classic) that a self-contained HTML report loads from a data: URI when the page is
# opened via file://, so both the old `format: dashboard` and a `format: html` report built on an
# htmlwidget (reactable, DT, ...) come up with blank tables; see stage-s6-report.md.
library(kableExtra)
source(file.path(params$script_dir, "jw_report.R")); jw_load(params$script_dir)
d <- jw_summary_data(params$week, params$root, as.Date(params$today))
esc_html <- function(v) { v <- ifelse(is.na(v), "", as.character(v)); v <- gsub("&", "&amp;", v, fixed = TRUE)
  v <- gsub("<", "&lt;", v, fixed = TRUE); v <- gsub(">", "&gt;", v, fixed = TRUE); v }
link_col <- function(v) ifelse(is.na(v) | !nzchar(v), "", sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">open</a>', esc_html(v)))
tbl <- function(x, url_col = "url") {
  if (is.null(x) || !nrow(x)) return(htmltools::p("none"))
  if (url_col %in% names(x)) x[[url_col]] <- link_col(x[[url_col]])
  for (col in setdiff(names(x), url_col)) if (is.character(x[[col]])) x[[col]] <- esc_html(x[[col]])
  knitr::kable(x, format = "html", escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE) |>
    kableExtra::scroll_box(height = "420px")
}
status_label <- if (length(d$incomplete)) paste0("INCOMPLETE (", length(d$incomplete), ")") else "Complete"
```

No search or sort: kableExtra's table is static CSS, not an interactive widget, so there is no in-table filter.
Use the browser's own find-in-page (Ctrl/Cmd-F) over the visible rows, or query `summary.md` / the stage
parquet files directly with `arrow` for anything that needs filtering.

## Summary

- **New this week:** `r nrow(d$new)`
- **Closing within 14 days:** `r nrow(d$soon)`
- **Near-misses:** `r if (is.null(d$near_miss)) 0 else nrow(d$near_miss)`
- **Status:** `r status_label`

## New opportunities (best class first)

```{r}
tbl(d$new[, c("class", "status", "employer", "title", "country", "track", "deadline", "url")])
```

## Closing within 14 days

```{r}
tbl(d$soon[, c("class", "status", "employer", "title", "deadline", "url")])
```

## Near-misses

Items that fail exactly one hard rule.

```{r}
tbl(d$near_miss[, c("employer", "title", "near_miss_rule", "why", "weakest_dimension", "evidence_url")], url_col = "evidence_url")
```

## Sources

Flag and status per source.

```{r}
tbl(d$sources[, c("section", "type", "status", "flag", "n_anchors", "n_job_like", "note", "url")])
```

## Discovery

Social and web leads.

```{r}
tbl(d$s5[, c("platform", "query", "query_type", "lead_status", "text", "url", "note")])
```

## Run log

### Stages

```{r}
tbl(data.frame(stage = names(d$stage_status), status = unname(d$stage_status)))
```

### Problems recorded this week (generic wording)

```{r}
tbl(d$problems[, c("stage", "severity", "code", "message", "n", "reported")])
```
